L97@P5: 5. Appearance
L98@P5: There shall be no such defects as scratch, rust, discoloration, leakage which may adversely
L99@P5: affect commercial value of the cell.
L100@P5: 6. Standard Test Conditions
L101@P5: 6.1 Environmental Conditions
L102@P5: Unless otherwise specified, all tests stated in this specification are
L103@P5: conducted at temperature 23± 3°and humidity under 65%.
L104@P5:  6.2 Measuring Equipment
L105@P5: (1) Amp-meter and Volt-meter
L106@P5: The amp-meter and volt-meter should have an accuracy of the grade 0.5mA and
L107@P5: mV or higher.
L108@P5: (2) Slide caliper
L109@P5: The slide caliper should have 0.01 mm scale.
L110@P5: (3) Impedance meter
L111@P5: The impedance meter with AC 1kHz should be used.
L112@P5: 7. Characteristics
L113@P5: 7.1 Standard Charge
L114@P5: This "Standard Charge" means charging the cell CCCV with charge current of 0.33C
L115@P5: (1,600mA) and constant voltage 4.2V and 0.025C(121mA) cut-off in CV mode at 23°C.
L116@P5: 7.2 Standard Discharge Capacity
L117@P5:  The standard discharge capacity is the initial discharge capacity of the
L118@P5: cell, which is measured with discharge current of 0.2C(970mA) wh 2.50V cut-off at
L119@P5: 23°C within 1 hour after the Standard charge.
L120@P5: Standard Discharge Capacit y ≥ 4,850mAh

L173@P7: 8. Mechanical Characteristics
L174@P7:  8.1 Drop Test
L175@P7: Test method: Each fully charged cell or battery is dropped three times from a height of
L176@P7: 1.0 m onto a concrete floor. The cells or batteries are dropped so as to
L177@P7: obtain impacts in random orientations. After the test, the sample shall be
L178@P7: put on rest for a minimum of one hour and then a visual inspection shall
L179@P7: be performed.
L180@P7: Criteria: No fire, no explosion
L181@P7: Drop test shall be performed with the following criteria IEC 62133
L182@P7:  8.2 Vibration Test
L183@P7: Test method: As to the UN transportation regulation(UN38.3), for each axis (X and Y
L184@P7: axis with cylindrical cells) 7Hz→200Hz→7Hz for 15min,
L185@P7: repetition 12 times totally 3hours, the acceleration 1g during 7 to 18Hz
L186@P7: and 8g (amplitude 1.6mm) up to 200Hz.
L187@P7: Criteria: No leakage, with less than 10mV of OCV drop
L188@P7: Vibration test shall be performed with the UN38.3 standard

L203@P8: 9. Safety
L204@P8: 9.1 Overcharge test
L205@P8: Test method: To charge the standard charged cell with 4.6V and 3C (14,550mA) at 23°C
L206@P8: for 7 hours
L207@P8: Criteria: No fire, and no explosion.
L208@P8: Overcharge test shall be performed with the UL1642 standard
L209@P8:  9.2 External short-circuit test
L210@P8: Test method: Fully rated charged cell is to be short-circuited by connecting the positive
L211@P8: and negative terminals of the battery with a circuit load having a
L212@P8: resistance load of 80 ±20 mΩ. The battery is to discharge until a fire or
L213@P8: explosion is obtained, or until it has reached a completely discharged
L214@P8: state of less than 0.2 V and the battery case temperature has returned to
L215@P8: ± 10°C of ambient temperature. The return to near ambient of the battery
L216@P8: (cell) casing in an indication of ultimate results.
L217@P8: Tests are to be conducted at 20 ± 5°C and at 55 ± 5°C.
L218@P8: Criteria: No fire, and no explosion.
L219@P8: External short-circuit test shall be performed with the UL1642 standard
L220@P8:  9.3 Forced discharge test
L221@P8: Test method: A discharged cell is subjected to a reverse charge at 1C(4,850mA)
L222@P8: for 90 min.
L223@P8: Criteria: No fire, and no explosion.
L224@P8: Forced discharge test shall be performed with the IEC62133 standard
L225@P8: 9.4 Heating test
L226@P8:  Test method: To heat up the standard charged cell at heating rate 5℃ per minute
L227@P8: up to 130℃ and keep the cell in oven for 30 min.
L228@P8: Criteria: No fire, and no explosion.
L229@P8: Heating test shall be performed with the UL1642 standard(10 min) & GB31241
L230@P8: standard(30 min).
L231@P8: 10. Warranty
L232@P8: Samsung SDI will be responsible for replacing the cell against defects or poor workmanship
L233@P8: for fifteen(15) months from the date of shipping. Any other problems caused by
L234@P8: malfunction of the equipment or unsuitable use of the cell are not under this warranty.
L235@P8-9: The warranty set forth in proper use, handling conditions described above, and excludes inSAMSUNG SDI Confidential Proprietary

L261@P13: Proper Use and Handling of Lithium Ion Cells
L262@P13: See before using lithium-ion cell
L263@P13: This document has been prepared to describe the appropriate cautions and prohibitions,
L264@P13: which the customer should take or employ when the customer uses and handles the lithium
L265@P13: ion cell to be manufactured and supplied by Samsung SDI Co., Ltd., in order to obtain
L266@P13: optimum performance and safety.
L267@P13: 1. Charging
L268@P13: 1.1 Charging current
L269@P13: Charging current should be less than maximum charge current specified in the product
L270@P13: specification.
L271@P13: 1.2 Charging voltage
L272@P13: Charging should be done by voltage less than that specified in the product
L273@P13: specification.
L274@P13: 1.3 Charging time
L275@P13: Continuous charging under specified voltage does not cause any loss of performance
L276@P13: characteristics. However, the charge timer is recommended to be installed from a
L277@P13: safety consideration, which shuts off further charging at time specified in the product
L278@P13: specification.
L279@P13: 1.4 Charging temperature
L280@P13: The cell should be charged within a range of specified temperatures in the
L281@P13: specification.
L282@P13: 1.5 Reverse charging
L283@P13: The cell should be connected, confirming that its poles are correctly aligned.
L284@P13: Inverse charging should be strictly prohibited. If the cell is connected improperly, it
L285@P13: may be damaged.
L286@P13: 2. Discharging
L287@P13: 2.1 Discharging
L288@P13: The cell shall be discharged continuously at less than maximum discharge current
L289@P13: specified in the product specification. In case of the higher discharge current should be
L290@P13: set, it shall be discussed together with SDI.
L291@P13: 2.2 Discharging temperature
L292@P13: 2.2.1 The cell should be discharged within a range of temperatures specified in the
L293@P13: product specification.
L294@P13-14: 2.2.2 Otherwise, it may cause loss of characteristics. SAMSUNG SDI Confidential Proprietary
L295@P14: Spec. No. INR21700-50G Version No. 0.1
L296@P14: 14
L297@P14: 2.3 Over-discharging
L298@P14: 2.3.1 The system should be equipped with a device to prevent further discharging
L299@P14: exceeding discharging cut-off voltage specified in the product specification.
L300@P14: 2.3.2 Over-discharging may cause loss of performance, characteristics of battery
L301@P14: function.
L302@P14: 2.3.3 Over-discharging may occur by self-discharge if the battery is left for a very long
L303@P14: time without any use.
L304@P14: 2.3.4 The charger should be equipped with a device to detect cell voltage and to
L305@P14: determine recharging procedures.
L306@P14: 3. Storage
L307@P14: 3.1 Storage conditions
L308@P14: 3.1.1 The cell should be stored within a range of temperatures specified in the product
L309@P14: specification.
L310@P14: 3.1.2 Otherwise, it may cause loss of performance characteristics, leakage and/or rust.
L311@P14: 3.2 Long-term storage
L312@P14: 3.2.1 The cell should be used within a short period after charging because long-term
L313@P14: storage may cause loss of capacity by self-discharging.
L314@P14: 3.2.2 If long-term storage is necessary, the cell should be stored at lower voltage
L315@P14: within a range specified in the product specification, because storage with higher
L316@P14: voltage may cause more loss of performance characteristics.
L317@P14: 3.2.3 Store the battery at 0 ~ 23℃, low humidity (below 65%), no dust and no
L318@P14: corrosive gas atmosphere.
L319@P14: 4. Cycle life
L320@P14: 4.1 Cycle life performance
L321@P14: 4.1.1 The cell can be charged/discharged repeatedly up to times specified in the
L322@P14: produce specification with a certain level of capacity also specified in the product
L323@P14: specification.
L324@P14: 4.1.2 Cycle life may be determined by conditions of charging, discharging, operating
L325@P14: temperature and/or storage.
L326@P14: 5. Battery Pack Assembly
L327@P14: 5.1 Prohibition of usage of damaged cell
L328@P14: 5.1.1 The cell should be inspected visually before battery assembly.
L329@P14: 5.1.2 The cell should not be used if sleeve-damage, can-distortion and/or
L330@P14-15: electrolyte-smell is detected. SAMSUNG SDI Confidential Proprietary
L331@P15: Spec. No. INR21700-50G Version No. 0.1
L332@P15: 15
L333@P15: 5.2 Terminals handling
L334@P15: 5.2.1 Excessive force on the negative terminal should be avoided when external strip
L335@P15: terminal is welled.
L336@P15: 5.3 Transportation
L337@P15: 5.3.1 If the cell is necessary to be transported to such as the battery manufacturer,
L338@P15: careful precautions should be taken to avoid damage of cell.
L339@P15: 6. Others
L340@P15: 6.1 Disassembly
L341@P15: 6.1.1 The cell should not be dismantled from the battery pack.
L342@P15: 6.1.2 Internal short-circuit caused by disassembly may lead to heat generation and/or
L343@P15: venting.
L344@P15: 6.1.3 When the electrolyte is coming in contact with the skin or eyes, wash
L345@P15: immediately with fresh water and seek medical advice.
L346@P15: 6.2 Short-circuiting
L347@P15: 6.2.1 Short-circuit results in very high current which leads to heat generation.
L348@P15: 6.2.2 An appropriate circuitry should be employed to protect accidental short-circuiting.
L349@P15: 6.3 Incineration
L350@P15: 6.3.1 Incinerating and disposing of the cell in fire are strictly prohibited, because it may
L351@P15: cause rupture and explosion.
L352@P15: 6.4 Immersion
L353@P15: 6.4.1 Soaking the cell in water is strictly prohibited, because it may cause corrosion and
L354@P15: leakage of components to be damaged to functions.
L355@P15: 6.5 Mixing use
L356@P15: 6.5.1 Different types of cell, or same types but different cell manufacturer's shall not
L357@P15: be used, which may lead to cell imbalance, cell rupture or damage to system due
L358@P15: to the different characteristics of cell.
L359@P15: 6.5.2 Do not mix use the cells from different batches/ranks even they are the same cell
L360@P15: types from the same manufacturer.
L361@P15: 6.6 Battery disposal
L362@P15: 6.6.1 Although the cell contains no environmentally hazardous component, such as
L363@P15: lead or cadmium. the battery should be disposed according to the local
L364@P15: regulations when it is disposed.
L365@P15: 6.6.2 The cell should be disposed with a discharged state to avoid heat generation by
L366@P15-16: an inadvertent short-circuit. SAMSUNG SDI Confidential Proprietary
L367@P16: Spec. No. INR21700-50G Version No. 0.1
L368@P16: 16
L369@P16: 6.7 Caution
L370@P16: 6.7.1 The Battery used in this device may present a risk of fire or chemical burn if
L371@P16: mistreated.
L372@P16: 6.7.2 Do not disassemble, expose to heat above 100℃ or incinerate it.
L373@P16: 6.7.3 Replace battery with Samsung SDI battery only.
L374@P16: 6.7.4 Use of another battery may present a risk of fire or explosion.
L375@P16: 6.7.5 Dispose of used battery promptly.
L376@P16: 6.7.6 Keep away from children.
L377@P16-17: 6.7.7 Do not disassemble and do not dispose of in fire. SAMSUNG SDI Confidential Proprietary

L380@P17: Pack Design Guideline for Lithium Ion Cells
L381@P17: If a customer’s battery pack cannot meet Pack Design Guideline,
L382@P17: SDI cannot take responsibility for a quality issue about a battery cell.
L383@P17: 1. Electrical design
L384@P17: 1.1 Charge
L385@P17: 1.1.1 Stop charging the battery if charging isn't completed within the specified time.
L386@P17: 1.1.2 The battery can be used within the following temperature ranges.
L387@P17: Don't exceed these ranges.
L388@P17: Charge temperature ranges : 0℃ ~ 45℃
L389@P17: 1.1.3 Charge current must be controlled by specified value in Cell specification.
L390@P17: 1.1.4 Cut-off Voltage of charging must be under 4.2V.
L391@P17: 1.1.5 Charger must stop charging battery by detecting either charging time or current
L392@P17: specified in Cell’s specification.
L393@P17: 1.1.6 Recharge Voltage must be at least 0.1V lower than Max charging Voltage.
L394@P17: 1.1.7 Do not charge the battery under 1.0V voltage.
L395@P17: 1.1.8 Voltage range of the battery for pre-charge mode is 1.0 ~ 3.0V with a charging
L396@P17: current of 0.1 ~ 0.5C
L397@P17: 1.2 Discharge
L398@P17: 1.2.1 Discharge current must be controlled by specified value in Cell’s specification.
L399@P17: 1.2.2 Cut-off Voltage of discharging must be over 2.5V.
L400@P17: 1.2.3 The battery can be used within the following temperature ranges.
L401@P17: Don't exceed these ranges.
L402@P17: Discharge temperature ranges : -20℃ ~ 60℃
L403@P17: 1.3 Storage
L404@P17: Store the battery at low temperature (below 60℃, 20℃ is recommended), low
L405@P17: humidity(below 65%), no dust and no corrosive gas atmosphere.
